name: Mixed Afrikaans/English price inquiry
description: Tests price lookup with a mixed Afrikaans/English message. The customer asks 'Wat kos die white melamine 16mm?' — 'Wat kos' is Afrikaans for 'What does it cost'. The AI should understand the mixed-language query and return the real price.

expected_behaviors.description: Reply should contain a price with R prefix
Reply should reference melamine in the product name

forbidden_patterns.description: No tool call debug text in reply

notes: Tests multilingual understanding. South African customers frequently mix Afrikaans and English. The AI should interpret 'Wat kos' as a price inquiry and return the correct price for 16mm white melamine from the hds_prices table.
